2607.27022.title: Evaluating Regional Bias in LLMs From Abstract Stereotype to Concrete Social Decision-Making
2607.27022.paper_summary: Regional bias in large language models (LLMs) may shape both perceptions of regional groups and decisions about individuals from different regions. Yet existing studies often examine these manifestations separately, leaving their structure and consequences unclear. We introduce Stereotypes-to-Decisions (S2D), a systematic framework evaluating regional bias from abstract stereotypes to concrete social decisions. Covering all 34 provincial-level administrative regions of China, S2D evaluates six LLMs using stereotype ratings of Warmth (perceived friendliness and trustworthiness) and Competence (perceived capability and intelligence), along with paired-choice tasks across Education, Occupation, and Social Interaction. Results reveal substantial regional differences in regional scores, with considerable agreement across models, especially for Competence and Occupation decisions. Furthermore, these patterns are associated with regional economic and digital development indicators and display mixed human-like stereotypes, with some regions rated highly on one dimension but poorly on the other. They also remain largely stable across Chinese and English prompts. Overall, our findings show that regional bias in LLMs is prevalent, systematic, and consequential, motivating more regionally aware evaluation and mitigation.
2607.27022.paper_summary_zh: 區域偏見在大型語言模型 (LLMs) 中可能會影響對區域群體的看法以及對來自不同地區個體的決策。<lb/>然而，現有研究往往分開檢視這些表現，導致其結構和後果不明確。<lb/>我們引入了刻板印象到決策 (S2D) 的系統框架，評估從抽象刻板印象到具體社會決策的區域偏見。<lb/>S2D涵蓋中國所有34個省級行政區，使用對於溫暖度（感知的友好和可信度）和能力（感知的能力和智力）的刻板印象評分，對六個LLMs進行評估，並進行教育、職業和社交互動的配對選擇任務。<lb/>結果顯示，區域分數存在顯著的區域差異，各模型之間在能力和職業決策方面尤其一致。<lb/>此外，這些模式與區域經濟和數位發展指標相關，並顯示出混合的人類刻板印象，一些地區在一個維度上評價很高，但在另一個維度上評價較低。<lb/>它們在中文和英文提示中也保持相對穩定。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究結果顯示，LLMs中的區域偏見是普遍存在的、系統性的且具有後果，促使我們進行更具區域意識的評估和減輕措施。
